from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

SOURCE_DIR = Path("/Users/warnes/CV/cv-builder/sessions/Genentech_SeniorRPackageDevelo_2026-03-18")
TARGET_DIR = Path("/Users/warnes/CV/cv-builder/sessions/Genentech_SeniorRPackageDevelo_2026-03-26")
MASTER_PATH = Path("/Users/warnes/CV/Master_CV_Data.json")

SKIP_NAMES = {
    ".pytest_cache",
    ".venv",
    "session.json",
    "session.json.answers_restore_20260325_1658.bak",
    "session.json.post_analysis_and_bullets_restore_20260324_003901.bak",
    "session.json.reset_overwrite_backup_20260323_1.bak",
}


def load_json(path: Path) -> dict:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


if TARGET_DIR.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f"Target already exists: {TARGET_DIR}")
if not SOURCE_DIR.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing source session: {SOURCE_DIR}")
if not MASTER_PATH.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing master CV: {MASTER_PATH}")

source_session = load_json(SOURCE_DIR / "session.json")
master_data = load_json(MASTER_PATH)

TARGET_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

for item in SOURCE_DIR.iterdir():
    if item.name in SKIP_NAMES:
        continue
    if item.name.startswith("session.json."):
        continue
    if item.name.startswith("."):
        continue
    if item.is_dir():
        continue
    shutil.copy2(item, TARGET_DIR / item.name)

state = source_session.get("state", {})
customizations = state.get("customizations") or {}
exp_recs = customizations.get("experience_recommendations") or []
old_id_order = [rec.get("id") for rec in exp_recs if isinstance(rec, dict) and rec.get("id")]
current_experiences = master_data.get("experience") or []
current_ids = [exp.get("id") for exp in current_experiences if isinstance(exp, dict) and exp.get("id")]
current_index = {exp_id: idx for idx, exp_id in enumerate(current_ids)}

old_edits = state.get("achievement_edits") or {}
remapped_edits: dict[str, object] = {}
for old_key, value in old_edits.items():
    try:
        old_idx = int(old_key)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        continue
    if old_idx < 0 or old_idx >= len(old_id_order):
        continue
    exp_id = old_id_order[old_idx]
    if exp_id not in current_index:
        continue
    remapped_edits[str(current_index[exp_id])] = value

state["achievement_edits"] = remapped_edits

exp_decisions = dict(state.get("experience_decisions") or {})
exp_decisions.pop("exp_007a", None)
state["experience_decisions"] = exp_decisions

for collection_key in ("recommended_experiences", "omitted_experiences"):
    values = list(customizations.get(collection_key) or [])
    customizations[collection_key] = [value for value in values if value != "exp_007a"]

state["customizations"] = customizations
state["generated_files"] = None
state["generation_state"] = {}
state["generation_progress"] = []
state["pending_rewrites"] = None
state["persuasion_warnings"] = []
state["phase"] = "customization"

new_session = {
    "session_id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:8],
    "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    "state": state,
    "conversation_history": source_session.get("conversation_history") or [],
}

(TARGET_DIR / "session.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(new_session, indent=2) + "\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)

summary = {
    "source": str(SOURCE_DIR),
    "target": str(TARGET_DIR),
    "new_session_id": new_session["session_id"],
    "copied_files": sorted(
        item.name
        for item in TARGET_DIR.iterdir()
        if item.is_file() and item.name != "session.json"
    ),
    "current_master_experience_ids": current_ids,
    "old_experience_order": old_id_order,
    "remapped_achievement_edit_keys": sorted(remapped_edits.keys(), key=int),
    "removed_exp_decision": "exp_007a",
}
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

```
